items.content:
In brief
- Binance has estimated the total impact of Thursday's security incident at around $6.3 billion, and said about $3 billion of it has been frozen onchain.
- The firm initially pointed to a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop, but now says its investigation has uncovered "additional points of breach."
- The exchange said it will cover all losses from its SAFU fund and company funds, and has reopened deposits while withdrawals remain suspended.
Binance has uncovered "additional points of breach" in Thursday's security incident, which it estimates cost around $6.3 billion, the exchange said on Friday, after initially pointing to a compromised engineer's laptop.
In an announcement late Thursday, Binance said a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop may have allowed an attacker to gain access to a service container and submit unauthorized withdrawal transactions. "We have found no evidence of any wallet private key leak," the exchange said.
Investigation update: Our initial investigation suggested that the security incident may have involved a compromised laptop, however our subsequent investigation has uncovered additional points of breach.
This was a complex attack, and we are doing all we can in coordination… pic.twitter.com/FQQ3vKT6GU
— Binance (@binance) October 30, 2026
Binance CEO Richard Teng said on Friday that the attacker "did not simply use one engineer's permissions, and this was not a single 'one-click' action," describing "a more complex attack process." "Our investigation has not attributed responsibility to any individual," he wrote.
"This was a complex attack," Binance said in its latest update, adding that it is still gathering the facts. Outflows stopped when it paused withdrawals, and it remains on track to resume them in 45 hours, the exchange said.
I want to speak to you directly about what happened.
Bottom line - your money is safe, and we're covering every loss.
Our initial investigation suggests this security incident may have started with a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop. That gave an attacker access to a…
— Richard Teng (@_RichardTeng) October 30, 2026
About $3 billion of the affected assets has been frozen onchain with the help of blockchain partners, Binance said. The exchange said it will cover all losses from its SAFU fund, an emergency reserve for users, and from company funds, and that "user funds are safe."
Binance initially suspended deposits and withdrawals, revoked the affected address authorization, and is working with law enforcement and blockchain intelligence firms to trace and recover the funds. By Friday morning, deposits were "operating as normal," Teng said, while withdrawals remain suspended as the exchange completes "a security revamp of the withdrawal service and its related addresses."
"We'll share a detailed technical post-mortem once the investigation is complete and every fact is verified—and publish an updated Proof of Reserves once remediation is complete," Teng wrote.
Blockchain analytics firm Arkham put the haul at $6.01 billion, taken from Binance hot wallets on nine blockchains between 4:10 p.m. and 7:05 p.m. ET on Thursday, it said in a tweet. Issuers had frozen $2.80 billion of it, but $2.9 billion in Ethereum, Bitcoin, Tron, Solana and other tokens could still be moved, according to Arkham.
The attacker has kept moving funds. Early Friday, the wallets sent $38.82 million in Ethereum to a new address, while still holding $1.12 billion in ETH, Arkham said. Hours later, a Tron address tagged by Arkham as belonging to the attacker sent about $2.1 million in TRX to nine new addresses in 14 transfers, according to Arkham data.
The stablecoin freeze
Stablecoin issuers moved quickly as the funds left Binance. Tether and Circle froze about 975.1 million USDT and 823 million USDC held in the main receiving wallet, worth about $1.8 billion, Decrypt reported on Thursday, when an onchain tally put the drain at $5.57 billion. Binance co-founder Changpeng "CZ" Zhao thanked the two issuers for their "quick freeze."
As of Friday morning, Arkham's entity page for the attacker showed holdings of about 18,270 BTC, 488,364 ETH, 663.6 million TRX and 970,551 SOL, alongside frozen stablecoin balances.

items.author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra
items.content:
Trezor warns CryptoBilis buyers to move funds over suspected implant
Trezor urged customers who bought devices from CryptoBilis since March to move their funds after a report of a suspected hardware implant.
Trezor has urged customers who bought its hardware wallets from former authorized reseller CryptoBilis since March to move their funds after a report of a suspected implant in a Safe 5 device.
Trezor said Friday that a customer in Indonesia reported an unauthorized circuit board inside a Trezor Safe 5 bought on Tokopedia in August. According to the report, the suspected implant could capture information displayed on the device’s screen, including wallet recovery phrases, and transmit it over a cellular network.
Trezor said it had not yet examined the device and had received no reports of related losses.
“We haven’t had the device in our lab yet, but we’re treating the report as credible, and we’d rather warn people now than wait for confirmation and find out someone lost their funds in the meantime,” Trezor chief commercial officer Danny Sanders told Cointelegraph.
A Trezor spokesperson said that the company described sales through the reseller as “very small” but declined to provide figures.
The spokesperson added that Trezor has not established where the suspected tampering occurred and is reviewing its hardware protections, acknowledging that existing safeguards, including seals and packaging, are not sufficient on their own.
Ledger tampering and earlier warnings to Trezor
The warning follows reports of crypto losses involving Ledger wallets sold through CryptoBilis that surfaced on Oct. 9. Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in one affected device.
Security researcher Joe Grand previously told Cointelegraph that he had alerted Trezor in August about tampered Trezor One and Model T wallets bought through unauthorized sellers on TikTok and Facebook. Trezor said its earlier claim of no evidence of compromised devices applied only to new wallets sold through authorized resellers.
Trezor said at the time that its setup checks targeted counterfeit devices and modified firmware, while the implant found in a CryptoBilis-sold Ledger read the screen without changing the firmware. A stolen recovery phrase can let an attacker restore a wallet on another device and move its funds.
Trezor announced plans to reduce its reseller network on Oct. 13.
Related: Tampered Ledger wallets cost Singapore users $2.7M: Police

items.author: solarist
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[glenstein]: Fun! One less than intuitive piece is that, as far as the game is concerned, evenly dividing a district 50-50 stops that district from counting toward anyone's majority. So if Blue was only present in a single district where its the majority, you could have ten more districts all evenly tied between Purple and Orange, and Blue would still win.

[tejstead]: I think this is basically a copy of Gerrymandle?

[chinathrow]: Related:  https://enclose.horse/

[Agentlien]: It's fun but I can barely see the difference between the horse and donkey colors which makes it really hard.

[jawns]: I am a big fan of both enclose.horse and gerrymandle.com.  I play both daily. But this rip-off of gerrymandle.com makes me feel less inclined to continue playing enclose.horse. And yes, it is a rip-off, not merely a riff on the general puzzle game of this type. It's akin to joke stealing among comedians.  It makes you lose respect for the joke stealer, even if their original stuff is good.

【微软：朝鲜黑客借 AI 批量钓鱼、伪造身份及开发恶意软件，加密机构为主要目标之一】

Foresight News 消息，微软威胁情报团队于 10 月 30 日发布报告表示，在其追踪的 8 个朝鲜黑客组织中，已有 3 个将 AI 全面融入攻击流程，4 个处于快速应用阶段，1 个正在扩大应用范围。微软认为，AI 已成为朝鲜黑客的「效率倍增器」，被广泛用于目标侦察、社会工程、身份伪造及恶意软件开发等环节，但相关攻击仍由人工主导，尚未实现完全自主。报告指出，朝鲜黑客组织发动网络攻击主要是为政权创收、搜集战略情报，主要目标包括加密及金融机构、IT 企业及软件供应链、政府和教育机构。在侦察环节，这些组织利用 AI 研究目标企业及员工、钱包、交易所和 DeFi 业务流程，以及漏洞、API 和云服务，从而快速积累发动针对性攻击所需的专业知识。例如，一个组织于 2026 年 6 月冒充一家 AI 区块链公司的招聘人员接触相关从业者，一周内即通过 3 家空壳公司发起同类攻击；另一组织自 2026 年 8 月起重新攻击油气行业，并成立虚假通信科技公司，以商业合作名义接触电信企业。在社会工程和身份伪造方面，朝鲜黑客组织利用 AI 批量生成钓鱼、招聘及投资类诱饵内容，翻译并调整语气以冒充外国人，伪造简历、面试回答、头像乃至语音视频。其中一个组织在 2026 年 8 月至 9 月期间生成了 100 余份针对韩国用户的定制化钓鱼 PDF 文件；以假身份受雇于海外企业的朝鲜远程 IT 人员，也在借助 AI 同时管理多个虚假身份。在恶意软件开发方面，朝鲜黑客组织借助 Cursor 等 AI 编程工具编写和调试代码，在被拦截后可快速更换工具规避检测。微软发现，2026 年 8 月一起针对 Rust 开发者的供应链攻击大概率使用了 AI，部分组织还开始在行动中使用开源 AI Agent 渗透测试框架 ARTEX。微软建议企业加强钓鱼防护及恶意软件检测，并严格核验远程求职者身份。Foresight News 此前消息，链上侦探 ZachXBT 表示币安攻击事件很可能由朝鲜黑客组织 Lazarus Group 实施，TRM Labs 则以高置信度将其归咎于 Lazarus Group 旗下的 TraderTraitor。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
Cursor扩展商店遭投毒：Claude Code被植入SSH后门，最多波及5000人

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Cursor 披露，10 月 29 日，其扩展市场出现遭恶意篡改的 Claude Code 2.1.313 版本。这个安装包并非 Anthropic 制作，在商店中上架了约 11 小时。Cursor 估计最多涉及 5000 名用户，将直接联系他们。

安全研究机构 OpenSourceMalware 分析发现，攻击者在插件的正常代码前面插入了 66 行恶意程序。只要编辑器加载该扩展，代码就会执行，甚至不需要用户与 Claude 聊天。

恶意程序会收集电脑名称、Git 邮箱、公网 IP 等信息，还会向 SSH 授权列表偷偷添加攻击者的密钥。随后尝试开启远程登录，通过反向 SSH 隧道连接攻击者服务器，并设置开机自动运行的后台任务，每隔约 60 秒尝试重新连接。

不过，攻击代码本身存在错误。Cursor 表示，大多数 Mac 和 Windows 电脑没有授予它开启 SSH 服务所需的管理员权限，因此攻击者通常无法通过隧道登录。但添加恶意密钥、安装后台脚本和发送设备信息仍可能成功。已经开启 SSH 服务的电脑也不能因此认定安全。

Cursor 已下架恶意版本，一度关闭整个扩展市场，并协助关停攻击者服务器。受影响用户需要检查 SSH 授权文件中是否存在 `svc-telemetry`，并使用官方修复脚本清理。只卸载扩展并不够，后台后门可能继续运行。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374652

items.content:
Strategy计划通过优先股融资增持比特币，Saylor称最高可创造300亿美元数字信贷

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 30 日，Strategy 执行董事长 Michael Saylor 在第三季度财报电话会议上表示，公司可利用现有资产负债表创造最高 300 亿美元的数字信贷，用于支持进一步购买比特币，无需额外发行普通股融资，也不依赖比特币价格进一步上涨。Saylor 表示，公司有能力创造 100 亿、200 亿乃至 300 亿美元的数字信贷。

Strategy CEO Phong Le 称，发行数字信贷将是公司获取更多比特币的主要方式。若公司通过 STRC 优先股在一个月内融资 10 亿至 20 亿美元，可将部分资金用于美元储备，其余用于购买比特币。

财报显示，Strategy 第三季度净利润为 195.3 亿美元，主要得益于数字资产价值增加 209.1 亿美元。截至 10 月 25 日，公司持有 848,517 枚 BTC，年初至今增持幅度达 26%。需要注意的是，300 亿美元代表潜在融资能力，并非公司已经宣布的融资目标。此外，Strategy 披露，CFO Andrew Kang 将于 11 月 5 日因个人原因离职。在新任 CFO Reza Virasteh 于 2027 年 1 月 1 日接任前，财务职能将由 Phong Le 负责。

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 30 日，Circle 计划自 2026 年 10 月 31 日起逐步降低旧版跨链传输协议 CCTP V1 的销毁限额，并于 12 月 1 日暂停相关合约，届时将无法再通过旧版路线进行 USDC 跨链转账。新版 CCTP（原 CCTP V2）采用独立合约与 API，不向后兼容，使用旧版的应用、钱包和桥接服务需主动更新集成。Circle 表示将保留足够的铸币额度，确保已获证明的待处理转账在暂停前完成，但具体限额档位及中间调整日期尚未披露。

此外，Noble 链不会接入新版 CCTP，Circle 计划于 2027 年 1 月 12 日暂停其 USDC 合约及剩余跨链路线。Noble 上的持有人需在此前转出 USDC，Circle 将在暂停当日对剩余余额进行快照，并于 1 月 13 日起启动人工赎回，申请者须满足合规与安全要求，且资产位于自控钱包。

Cognition收购Corridor：先请来安全主管，再把他的老东家买下

动察 Beating AI 快讯，AI 编程公司 Cognition 宣布收购安全初创公司 Corridor，交易金额未披露。Corridor 今年 3 月刚以 2 亿美元估值融资 2500 万美元，专门解决 AI 写代码带来的安全问题。

与传统的事后漏洞扫描不同，Corridor 可以直接接入 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等编程工具，在 AI 生成代码时检查安全风险，还能阻止存在严重漏洞的代码合并。它的客户包括 LangChain、Lovable 和 ElevenLabs。

这笔收购早有铺垫。9 月 29 日，Cognition 刚聘请 Corridor 前安全主管、前 Facebook 首席安全官 Alex Stamos 负责安全业务。10 月 26 日，又升级 Devin Security，接入 Claude Mythos 等前沿安全模型，不仅能扫描复杂漏洞，还能评估实际危害，让 Devin 自动复现、修复并测试。

Corridor 擅长在代码写出来时拦截风险，Devin Security 则已经具备深度扫描和批量修复能力。收购后，Cognition 准备把两套能力结合起来，让 AI 不仅负责写代码，还能参与从开发到上线的安全把关。

【韩国 FIU 申请封锁 2 家未申报加密货币运营商的境内访问】

Foresight News 消息，据韩联社报道，韩国金融情报分析院（FIU）10 月 30 日表示，已向韩国广播媒体通信审议委员会申请封锁 TetherMax、SuperTrust 两家未申报加密货币运营商的境内访问。同日，韩国数字资产交易所联盟（DAXA）以涉嫌违反《特定金融交易信息报告与利用法》（特金法）未申报经营加密货币业务为由，将 Aegis Ventures、TetherMax、SuperTrust 三家加密货币运营商移交调查，其中 Aegis Ventures 因无独立网站及 App，未被列入封锁申请对象。根据特金法，未申报经营加密货币业务可处 5 年以下有期徒刑或约 3.8 万美元（5000 万韩元）以下罚款，境外运营商若面向韩国用户经营同样适用。FIU 表示，此次被查处的运营商平均交易手续费为 1.5% 至 10%，最高达韩国五大韩元交易所平均水平（0.16%）的 62 倍。截至目前，因未向 FIU 申报而被移交调查机关的加密货币运营商已增至 47 家。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
Factory发布Droid 1.0：默认启用Code Mode，大幅减少Token消耗

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Factory 发布 Coding Agent 运行框架 Droid 1.0，引入程序化工具调用（Code Mode），并将其设为默认执行方式。AI 可以先编写 JavaScript 脚本，再通过脚本连续调用数百次工具，不用每执行几步就重新请求大模型，从而减少模型调用次数和 Token 消耗。

例如，迁移并核查 151 条 Linear 工单，传统方式预计需要 36 次模型请求、310 万输入 Token。改用 Code Mode 后，实际只需 2 次请求、约 6.1 万 Token，输入 Token 减少约 98%。在更广泛的测试中，使用 Claude Opus 5.5 的任务成本降低约 15%。

Factory 还优化了不同模型的工具调用策略、缓存和任务执行机制。在 Terminal-Bench 4 官方自测中，使用相同的 GPT-6.1 Sol 模型，Droid 比 Codex 高 3.5 分，成功任务成本降低 12%，但耗时增加 10%。

Code Mode 并非新技术。Cloudflare、Anthropic 此前已公开类似方案，Pi、OpenCode 2.0 和 DeepSeek Harness 也已支持。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
Herdr不只做Agent版tmux了：新桌面端能让AI自己修改界面和功能

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Herdr 原本是一款专为 AI 编程工具设计的终端管理器，可以理解为 Agent 版 tmux。开发者能同时运行多个 Claude Code、Codex，查看任务进度，让 Agent 互相派活、等待结果。即使关掉终端窗口，后台任务也能继续运行。

现在 Herdr 又推出两个开源项目：全新的 herdr-core 运行时，以及基于它开发的原生桌面应用。

herdr-core 把原来集成在终端工具里的后台能力重新开发为独立服务，并提供标准化接口。开发者可以直接通过它运行、调度 Agent，也能以此开发自己的桌面或手机应用，不必围绕原来的 TUI 架构做适配。

它还增加了独立的终端持有进程。只要这个进程仍在运行，即使 Core 本身崩溃或升级，正在执行的任务也不会随之中断。

配套的桌面应用把界面布局、快捷键和功能面板开放为可修改的本地文件。比如想把等待审批的 Agent 集中放在右侧，或者给每个任务加上运行计时器，只需告诉 Codex，它就能修改对应的布局或 JavaScript 文件，保存后界面自动更新，不必重新编译软件。

旧版 Herdr TUI 仍会继续维护，与新 Core 暂不共享运行中的任务。三个项目均采用 Apache 2.0 开源协议。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374619

动察 Beating AI 快讯，马斯克 10 月 30 日承认，Grok 4.8 的研发耗时超出预期，但保证新模型「不会让人失望」。他表示，团队并不针对基准测试优化，自己也不在乎跑分，更看重模型的实际用途。

items.author: wublockchainenglish
items.content:
Aave Freezes V3 and V4 Markets After Binance Exploiter Deposits $60M USDT and Borrows 19,762 WETH

Aave risk service provider LlamaRisk said one wallet linked to the Binance exploiter deposited about 60 million USDT into Aave V3 Ethereum Core and borrowed 19,762 WETH (worth roughly $44.6 million) between 20:58 and 21:01 UTC on October 29, about 40 minutes before the first freeze. The position remains over-collateralized and is the exploiter’s only position on Aave.

Aave froze all DAO-operated V3 and V4 markets as a precaution after a potential security incident involving Binance-affiliated wallets, pausing new deposits and borrowing. Users can still withdraw assets and repay existing loans. In total, 175 V3 reserves across 16 networks and 117 V4 reserves across four networks were frozen. Aave said its contracts were unaffected and it aims to lift the freeze as soon as possible. — link

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
Google关闭Jules：5月还在重做2.0，如今转向Antigravity

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Google 宣布，旗下 AI 编程工具 Jules 将于 12 月 31 日停运，11 月 11 日后转为只读。Jules 主打云端异步编程，开发者交代任务后，AI 就能在后台修 Bug、写测试，最后提交代码修改。

今年 5 月，Jules 团队还在 Reddit 招募 2.0 内测用户，称正在从头重做产品，准备推出新版网页界面、API 和 CLI，甚至想从帮人写代码扩展到帮人决定该做什么产品。

当时有人质疑 Jules 与 Antigravity 是否在内部竞争。团队明确否认，称两者互补，还透露 Jules 的编程部分本就使用 Antigravity 的 Agent 和执行框架。

但仅过了五个月，Google 就决定关闭 Jules，将其异步后台执行的研发经验转向 Antigravity。今年 5 月，Google 还宣布将个人版 Gemini CLI 转向 Antigravity CLI。几条并行的 AI 编程产品路线，正在向 Antigravity 收拢。

items.content:
Strategy eyes more Bitcoin buys as Saylor touts $30B credit capacity
Michael Saylor says Strategy could create up to $30 billion in digital credit without new common-stock fundraising or further Bitcoin price gains, as the company plans more BTC purchases.
Bitcoin treasury company Strategy is looking to finance more Bitcoin purchases through preferred-share offerings, with executive chairman Michael Saylor saying it has the capacity to create as much as $30 billion in digital credit.
During Strategy’s third-quarter earnings call, Saylor said the company could generate the amount using its existing balance sheet, without an additional common-stock capital raise or further Bitcoin price appreciation.
“We could create $10 billion, $20 billion, $30 billion of digital credit,” Saylor said.
The potential financing capacity highlights the company’s shift toward preferred shares such as STRC to fund Bitcoin accumulation rather than relying primarily on convertible debt or common-share sales.
CEO Phong Le said during the call that issuing digital credit would be the main method for acquiring more Bitcoin. “The primary way to acquire Bitcoin is by issuing digital credit,” Le said.
Le said that if Strategy raised $1 billion to $2 billion in a month through STRC, it could put some proceeds into dollar reserves and spend the rest on Bitcoin.
The company reported $19.53 billion in third-quarter net income, driven largely by a $20.91 billion gain in the value of its digital assets. Its Bitcoin holdings reached 848,517 BTC as of Oct. 25, up 26% year to date.
The $30 billion figure represents a possible capacity, not an announced fundraising target.
Strategy also disclosed that CFO Andrew Kang will step down on Nov. 5 for personal reasons, with Le overseeing the finance function until Reza Virasteh takes over as CFO on Jan. 1, 2027.
Related: Strategy skips Bitcoin purchases, spends $205M on STRC buybacks

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
North Korea’s TraderTraitor linked to $6.3B Binance hack
TRM Labs says it has high confidence in the attribution, while ZachXBT identified stolen funds from the Binance and Bitget hacks converging at the same address.
Cybersecurity researchers from TRM Labs and Chainalysis, along with onchain investigator ZachXBT, have linked the $6.3 billion Binance hack to North Korea’s TraderTraitor group.
TRM Labs attributed the attack to TraderTraitor with “high confidence,” citing onchain and offchain intelligence.
Onchain investigator ZachXBT said funds stolen from Binance and the earlier Bitget exploit were commingled at the same address after moving through THORChain.
“This indicates the same actor is likely behind both incidents,” he said, adding that the Bitget attack had been attributed to TraderTraitor.
Chainalysis co-founder and CEO Jonathan Levin also pointed to TraderTraitor, saying the group stole $6.4 billion, slightly above Binance’s estimated $6.3 billion impact.
“We assess Binance hack for $6.4B was likely done by DPRK group TraderTraitor due to links to previous hack,” he said.
The attribution follows an earlier assessment by Blockaid CEO Ido Ben-Natan, who told Cointelegraph that the attack’s sophistication and onchain preparations resembled North Korean activity.
US authorities have linked TraderTraitor to some of crypto’s largest thefts, including the Bybit hack in February 2025. The FBI also joined US and Japanese investigators in attributing the theft of more than $300 million from DMM Bitcoin in May 2024 to the North Korean actors.
The FBI says TraderTraitor targets company employees through social engineering. In the DMM case, an attacker posing as a recruiter sent a malicious coding test to an employee of wallet provider Ginco. Investigators said the resulting access was likely used to manipulate a legitimate transaction request, diverting funds to attacker-controlled wallets.
Related: Bitget CEO suspects North Korea behind $352M hack, citing IP clues

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 30 日，据韩联社报道，微软威胁情报 29 日发布的报告显示，朝鲜黑客组织正利用人工智能加快对韩国用户的网络攻击，从定制钓鱼文档、假招聘与身份伪装，扩展到恶意代码开发与软件供应链攻击。

微软对 8 个朝鲜相关黑客组织的 AI 采用水平做了评估：其中 3 个已达四级中最高的「运营定型」阶段，将 AI 融入日常攻击流程；另有 4 个处于「加速」阶段、1 个处于「扩展」阶段。报告称，有组织在今年 8–9 月针对不同目标定制生成逾 100 份 PDF 诱饵文档，并出现数分钟内批量产出数十份的情形。今年 6 月 8–12 日，还出现利用 3 家伪装公司，向 AI、区块链与网络安全从业者发起假招聘邀约的案例。

此外，微软分析朝鲜黑客可能借助 Cursor 等 AI 编程工具辅助代码生成、排错与规避检测；朝鲜侦察总局下属「Onyx Sleet」（韩方称安达利尔）与「Pearl Sleet」自 10 月下旬起，已在实战中使用开源 AI 渗透测试框架 ARTEX。微软认为，上述组织虽借 AI 提升了攻击速度与效率，但尚未进入完全自主攻击阶段，并建议企业加强求职者身份核验、钓鱼防护与恶意代码检测。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
Sabi让AI从脑信号学习个人审美，生成的人脸越来越符合喜好

动察 Beating AI 快讯，脑机接口公司 Sabi 公布了一项名为 RLNF（神经反馈强化学习）的新研究。演示中，一张 AI 人脸不断变化，逐渐变成更符合观看者审美的模样。研究人员希望让 AI 从脑信号中了解每个人的喜好，而不必反复询问用户哪张图片更好看。

团队先让 5 名受试者观看大量人脸，同时记录脑电和眼动，并让他们给每张脸的吸引力打分。通过这些数据，AI 学习每个人看到喜欢或不喜欢的人脸时，会出现什么样的生理反应，从而建立个人审美偏好模型。

随后，研究人员利用这些偏好数据，通过强化学习微调 FLUX.2 Klein 4B 图像模型。AI 每生成一批新的人脸，系统就拿它们与此前记录的人脸进行比较，根据脑信号推测出的个人喜好给出奖励。模型不断根据奖励调整，逐渐学会生成更符合特定用户审美的人脸，整个过程不需要受试者再逐张打分。

此前已有研究利用脑电反馈引导 AI 生成人们喜欢的人脸。Sabi 则将这种反馈用于图像模型的强化学习，让个人审美直接影响模型的生成倾向。

不过，实验目前只有 5 名参与者，其中 2 人的喜好主要靠眼部活动判断，而非直接从大脑活动中识别。要证明脑电能可靠地反映个人审美，还需要更多实验。

零一万物获杭州国资数亿元投资：从自己训练大模型，转向帮企业用AI赚钱

动察 Beating AI 快讯，李开复创办的零一万物宣布，10 月 28 日与杭州市、临平区达成合作。市、区两级国资将合计投资数亿元，公司总部将落地杭州临平，并建设产业 AI 转型基地。双方计划围绕企业经营、生产运营和供应链等场景开展 AI 项目。

零一万物曾是国内「大模型六小虎」之一，早期凭借自研 Yi 系列模型进入行业第一梯队。但 2025 年初，公司调整超大模型预训练团队，逐步退出超大模型军备竞赛。今年 9 月，又正式停止面向外部用户的模型 API 服务。

如今，零一万物主要基于 DeepSeek、千问等开源模型，为企业开发经营决策和业务管理系统，并派工程师深入客户现场完成部署。李开复此前披露，公司 2025 年实现 5 亿元订单、2.5 亿元经审计收入；2026 年前 5 个月订单额已超过 15 亿元。

零一万物还计划于 2027 年赴港 IPO。此前，公司已在四川内江、武汉等地布局 AI 产业基地项目。这次落地杭州，除了获得国资投资，还能对接当地企业的实际业务需求，为旗下 AI 产品寻找更多客户。

Binance hack could accelerate shift to DEXs: Standard Chartered
Standard Chartered’s Geoffrey Kendrick said the breach could accelerate a shift toward decentralized trading and strengthen his case for Uniswap’s UNI token reaching $100 by 2030.
The Binance hack could accelerate a shift in crypto trading toward decentralized exchanges, benefiting Uniswap over the longer term, according to Standard Chartered’s global head of digital assets research, Geoffrey Kendrick.
In an email shared with Cointelegraph, Kendrick said the breach should drive further growth in decentralized exchanges’ share of trading relative to centralized platforms, though investors should wait until after the impact of the Binance attack has time to play out in the markets.
“I would encourage investors to re-engage with Uniswap,” said Kendrick. “The decentralized exchange (DEX) has never had any exploits, and the hack of the largest centralized exchange (CEX), in Binance, should see the ratio of DEX to CEX trading continue to increase.”
CoinGecko research shows that the top 10 spot DEX-to-CEX ratio was 23.5% in the second quarter of 2026, climbing 2.1 percentage points from the first quarter of 2026.
Kendrick said he retains his $100 price target for Uniswap (UNI) for 2030, but said the Binance hack is “another reason why that forecast may end up being too low.”
The forecast builds on Standard Chartered’s earlier thesis that assets locked in DeFi could reach $2.7 trillion by 2030, with Uniswap emerging as a key trading venue for tokenized assets.
Looking at the broader implications of the Binance hack, Kendrick said he expects there will be further negative price action in the near term.
Cointelegraph reported that cryptocurrency markets extended their decline early Friday following the Binance hack, with BNB down more than 8% over 24 hours and Bitcoin trading near $77,000. Decentralized finance tokens also declined. Aave’s AAVE fell 11.3% to $118.54, while Uniswap’s UNI dropped 10.4% to $6.48, according to CoinGecko.
“Only after assets are unfrozen and more detail of the hack emerges will we find a new base,” said Kendrick.

items.content:
ServiceNow单日暴跌27%，AI初创公司Serval融资1.5亿美元挑战其核心业务

动察 Beating AI 快讯，10 月 29 日，企业软件巨头 ServiceNow 股价暴跌 26.95%，市值蒸发约 420 亿美元。公司第三季度营收仍增长 20.5%，但预计第四季度未来一年合同收入的增速将从 20.5% 放缓至 18.5%，加剧了市场对 AI 冲击传统软件业务的担忧。

同一天，AI 初创公司 Serval 宣布完成红杉资本领投的 1.5 亿美元融资，估值达到 30 亿美元。它瞄准的正是 ServiceNow 的核心业务。

ServiceNow 主要帮大型企业管理内部事务。比如员工入职要开通账号、领取电脑、申请系统权限，或者设备坏了需要报修，都可以通过它提交工单，再由系统分配任务、安排审批和执行操作。企业要新增或修改复杂的自动化流程，通常还需要专门人员配置规则、编写脚本。

Serval 想用 AI 改变这套做法。员工只需用自然语言描述需求，AI Agent Catalyst 就能生成对应的自动化代码，经过管理员审核后执行。Serval 还开发了自己的工单、资产管理和审批系统，准备把 ServiceNow 整套替换掉。创始人透露，电动车制造商 Lucid Motors 只用了 45 天，就把原本运行在 ServiceNow 上的 IT 工单、配置数据库和软硬件资产管理等业务迁到了 Serval。

不过，ServiceNow 也在反击。10 月初，它推出 AI 原生服务台 Flow。28 日公布的第三季度数据显示，客户续约率仍达 98%，公司还将今年 AI 年度合同价值目标上调至 17 亿美元。

两家公司现在都在派工程师深入客户企业，帮忙重新设计业务流程。Serval 计划未来一年招聘超过 100 名自动化工程师，ServiceNow 则已与埃森哲合作开展类似项目。AI 能帮企业更快地编写自动化程序，但要真正替换旧系统，还得处理多年积累的数据、权限和复杂业务流程。

items.content:
Anthropic新安全措施：Claude每次回答后，还会在后台审查你们的聊天记录

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Anthropic 披露了一套名为「自我评估」的安全机制。从今年 6 月开始，Claude 在回答用户后，还会在后台检查刚才的对话，判断有没有诈骗、网络攻击等滥用风险，并给出风险等级。用户看不到这一步，系统也不会因此立即拦截回答。

过去，Anthropic 主要依靠额外的安全分类器识别违规行为。现在，Claude 可以利用刚刚处理过的对话上下文，自己完成初步审查。平均只需多生成约 10 个 Token，额外推理算力不到 2%。

这套机制已经发现传统安全系统漏掉的问题。今年 8 月，单个 API 客户触发超过 10 万条涉及儿童性剥削的风险警报。9 月，系统又发现有人利用 Claude Code 自动实施恋爱诈骗，针对数十名受害者。Anthropic 调查后封禁了相关账号，并将前一事件报告给美国有关机构。

但 Claude 并不总能识破恶意行为。Anthropic 在关闭常规防护的 24 项网络攻击测试中，尝试用自我评估实时拦截，仍有 13 项攻击成功。因此，这套机制目前主要用于事后监控，而不是实时阻止用户操作。

Wabi融资5500万美元、估值12.5亿美元，个人AI助手才全面开放10天

动察 Beating AI 快讯，AI 陪伴应用 Replika 创始人 Eugenia Kuyda 的新公司 Wabi 宣布完成 5500 万美元 A 轮融资，估值达到 12.5 亿美元。IVP 领投，a16z、Forerunner 和亚马逊 Alexa 基金等参投。加上去年 11 月的 2000 万美元融资，Wabi 不到一年已累计融资 7500 万美元。

Wabi 去年讲的还是「App 版 YouTube」：让普通人一句话生成小程序，再分享给别人使用和修改。今年 9 月底，它转向个人 AI 助手，主打在群聊里预约服务、安排行程、处理日常事务，还能按需生成清单、日程表和小游戏。

Kuyda 此前接受 TechCrunch 采访时承认，团队发现用户虽然喜欢个性化软件，却未必愿意花时间自己制作。新版 Wabi 因此改由 AI 主动生成所需的小程序。

不过，Wabi 的个人 AI 助手直到 10 月 19 日才全面开放。公司虽然在融资公告中强调「需求旺盛」，却没有公布活跃用户、留存或收入数据。Kuyda 在 10 天前还表示，产品目前免费，商业模式尚未确定。

Blockaid Reveals How Hacker Took Control of Binance Wallet: One of 50 EIP-7702 Authorizations Succeeded

According to analysis by blockchain security firm Blockaid, the attacker used Ethereum’s EIP-7702 authorization mechanism to attack Binance’s Binance 14 hot wallet. Because the attacker could not determine the hot wallet’s live nonce, and EIP-7702 authorizations must match the account’s nonce at the time of transaction execution, the attacker submitted 50 authorizations with different nonces (18914775 to 18914824) in a single Type-4 transaction. Only one matched successfully, allowing the malicious delegation to take effect.

The successful authorization delegated the hot wallet’s account code to an unverified malicious asset-transfer contract. The contract allows only the address designated by the attacker to execute the sweep() function, which can transfer ETH and ERC-20 tokens from the wallet while retaining 1 ETH for gas fees. Subsequent incoming assets may also be at risk of being transferred. — link

Binance said its initial investigation suggests the security incident may have involved a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop, allowing the attacker to access a service container and submit unauthorized withdrawal transactions. The exchange said it has found no evidence that any wallet private keys were leaked.

Binance estimates the total impact at approximately $6.3 billion, with around $3 billion in affected assets frozen on-chain. Deposits and withdrawals have been temporarily suspended, and the affected address authorization has been revoked. Binance said it will cover all losses through its SAFU fund and company funds, with a detailed technical post-mortem to follow. — link

items.content:
OpenAI 28天产品冲刺Day25：Tibo玩起额度版朝三暮四，Pro 200腰斩计划取消

动察 Beating AI 快讯，OpenAI 的 28 天产品冲刺来到 Day 25，Tibo 今天终于不按 Reset 了，直接宣布给全体用户加额度。

【Canton Development Fund  批准 RedStone 的 CAPS 提案，将建立机构级隐私数据标准】

Foresight News 消息，据 RedStone 官方公告，Canton Development Fund 已于 9 月 16 日一致通过 RedStone 提出的「Canton 访问和隐私标准」（Canton Access and Privacy Standard，CAPS）提案，并批准为期 12 个月的开发计划。该提案旨在为 Canton Network 建立统一的机构级定价数据标准，使参与交易的机构能够使用同一参考价格，同时对各自的持仓、交易条款及估值结果保密，包括不向数据提供商披露相关信息。CAPS 采用开源 Daml 原生框架，允许 Canton 上的机构对基金、私人资产和抵押品进行定价，而无需向交易之外的任何人（包括数据提供商）显示其持仓或协商条款。CAPS 的首批两个实现方案由 Zenith 和 Memora 担任设计合作伙伴。Memora 计划将 CAPS 用于储备金证明。根据提案，开发计划为期 12 个月，共分为 8 个里程碑，总预算为 1,577.5 万枚 Canton Coin（按基准价格计算约 183 万美元），其中一半款项将在达到网络采用相关里程碑后支付。首阶段将制定协议规范并提交 Canton Improvement Proposal（CIP），供 Canton 治理机制审议。

Strategy Reports $19.53 Billion in Q3 Net Income, Sells $432 Million in Bitcoin in 2026

Strategy reported $19.53 billion in net income for Q3 2026, compared with $2.79 billion a year earlier, largely driven by $20.91 billion in digital asset gains. The company also disclosed that it sold approximately $431.8 million worth of Bitcoin year-to-date to fund a portion of its preferred stock dividends and STRC share repurchases. items.author: Protos Staff
items.content:
Billions of dollars worth of digital assets left wallets controlled by the world’s largest crypto exchange, Binance, on Thursday afternoon New York time.
Pending the success of any recovery efforts, the dollar value of missing assets tentatively rank Binance’s loss today among the largest heists in world history.
Withdrawals that founder Changpeng Zhao (CZ) would eventually characterize as a hack began no later than 4:30pm, with researchers identifying smaller, prior transactions by the alleged hacker(s) throughout the day.
As illegitimate withdrawals continued, Binance began halting withdrawals sometime around 6pm, with an official pause announcement at 6:22pm.
By 8pm, Arkham Intelligence estimated the value of illegitimate withdrawals had already exceeded $5.8 billion. Loss estimates varied widely, from Binance’s $2.54 billion declaration at 7:22pm to more than double that figure according to third-party researchers.
Binance’s social media account, as well as CEO Hi Ye, swore that the giant exchange would somehow reimburse customers for any losses.
Live updates from the October 29 Binance hack
Stablecoin issuers Tether, Circle, World Liberty Financial, and Paxos quickly froze stablecoins to assist Binance.
At 7:06pm, Binance said Binance Alpha trading was suspended. CEO He said a post-mortem would follow after staff finish the investigation.
This is a developing situation, with updates arriving by the minute.
Protos is liveblogging this event below. Scroll down and refresh this page for additional updates as they arrive.
Got a tip? Send us an email securely via Protos Leaks. For more informed news and investigations, follow us on X, Bluesky, and Google News, or subscribe to our YouTube channel.

Arbitrum Security Council Takes Emergency Action to Transfer Binance-Related Stolen Funds to an Intermediary Frozen Wallet

The Arbitrum Security Council announced that it has taken emergency action to rescue 74,559,805 ARB and 8,425 ETH held in an address on Arbitrum One identified as connected to the Binance exploit. The Security Council acted after weighing its commitment to the security and integrity of the Arbitrum community and Arbitrum governance, without impacting any Arbitrum users or applications.

After significant technical diligence and deliberation, the Security Council identified and executed a technical approach to move the funds to safety without affecting any other chain state or other Arbitrum users. As of October 30, 2026, the funds have been successfully transferred to an intermediary frozen wallet. The funds are no longer accessible to the address that originally held them and can only be moved by further action of the Security Council or a vote of Arbitrum DAO governance, which will be coordinated with relevant parties. — link

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Binance points to engineer’s hacked laptop in $6.3B breach
Binance said attackers may have used a compromised DevOps laptop to access internal infrastructure.
Update (Oct. 30 at 2:44 am UTC): This article has been updated to include Binance’s preliminary investigation into the security breach.
Binance said its initial investigation into the multi-billion crypto breach pointed to a compromised DevOps engineer’s laptop.
The exchange said on Friday that the laptop compromise may have allowed an attacker to access a service container and submit unauthorized withdrawal transactions. It said it had found no evidence of a wallet private-key leak, though its investigation remains ongoing.
Speaking to Cointelegraph on Thursday, Blockaid CEO Ido Ben-Natan said Blockaid’s preliminary assessment also pointed to “key misuse,” in which attackers tricked or compromised a signing system into authorizing malicious transactions without extracting the underlying private key
“It seems to be … a compromise of signing infrastructure. We don’t think a key was leaked,” he said.
Ben-Natan’s assessment drew on Blockaid’s experience with similar attacks and its observations of the onchain activity.
Binance estimates $6.3 billion impact, freezes about $3 billion
Binance has now put the estimated total impact at around $6.3 billion and said it had worked with blockchain partners to freeze about $3 billion in stolen assets onchain.
The exchange said it would cover all losses using its Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU) and company funds, adding that user funds were safe. It also pledged to publish an updated Proof of Reserves.
Binance temporarily suspended deposits and withdrawals while conducting security checks and said it had revoked the affected address authorization. It is working with law enforcement and blockchain intelligence partners to trace and recover funds.
The exchange said it would publish a detailed technical post-mortem once the investigation was complete and the facts fully verified.
Blockaid identifies malicious wallet delegation
In its onchain analysis published on X, Blockaid said the attacker bundled 50 EIP-7702 authorizations into a single transaction targeting Binance 14. One authorization reportedly matched the account’s required nonce, allowing it to be accepted.
EIP-7702 allows an account to delegate execution to smart-contract code. Blockaid said the affected account was delegated to an unverified sweeper contract that allowed a designated operator to drain tokens and Ether.
Related: Binance hack rattles crypto markets as BNB falls 7%, Bitcoin slides
Ben-Natan told Cointelegraph the operation could have involved multiple compromised devices and movement through the exchange’s network.
Before Binance’s latest update, Arkham CEO Miguel Morel told Cointelegraph there was insufficient information to determine whether the attack involved stolen keys or compromised infrastructure.
“From what we can tell, it appears the hack is still ongoing,” he said at the time.
North Korea, Bybit comparison
Asked whether the suspected signing manipulation resembled the February 2025 Bybit attack, Ben-Natan described the incidents as “very, very similar.”
In that case, Bybit’s published forensic update said attackers compromised a Safe developer’s credentials, accessed the wallet provider’s infrastructure and deceived signers into approving a malicious transaction.
Ben-Natan also said the activity resembled operations linked to North Korea, citing Blockaid’s familiarity with those attacks. He pointed to sophisticated onchain preparations but emphasized that the attribution remained unconfirmed.
Binance has not identified the attackers, saying it is working with law enforcement to establish their identities.
Magazine: Tampered Ledger reported in Singapore a month before news broke: Asia Express

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 30 日，闪迪公布 2027 财年第一财季业绩，营收约 110 亿美元，环比增长 23%，同比增长约 378%。非公认会计准则稀释后每股收益 49.51 美元，调整后毛利率约 85.1%。当季回购约 320 万股，耗资约 50 亿美元。公司称数据中心相关需求旺盛，推动业务增长。

items.content:
Coinbase Q3财报：营收约12.16亿美元同比降35%，调整后EBITDA约3.33亿美元

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 30 日 Coinbase 公布 2026 年三季报，总营收约 12.16 亿美元，同比下降 35%，其中交易营收约 5.90 亿美元，订阅及服务营收约 5.70 亿美元。净利润约 7.19 亿美元，稀释后每股收益 2.51 美元，高于去年同期约 4.33 亿美元。调整后 EBITDA 约 3.33 亿美元，低于去年同期约 8.01 亿美元。

公司称营收下滑主要受消费者现货交易量下降约 59%、机构现货交易量下降约 53% 拖累，部分被收购 Deribit 后的衍生品业务增长所抵消。净利润受益于投资性加密资产约 7.15 亿美元收益。运营支出同比减少约 17% 至约 11.5 亿美元，反映 5 月宣布的重组约裁员 700 人及相关营销开支下降。同期，平台预测市场年化收入已超 2 亿美元，产品内平均 USDC 持有量约 220 亿美元，再创历史新高。

据 BIT 股票平台数据显示，Coinbase (COIN) 收盘跌 1.07%，收盘再跌 4.65%。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374475

items.content:
Strategy Q3财报：营业利润约209亿美元创新高，比特币持仓848,517枚，CFO将离任

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 30 日，Strategy 公布 2026 年三季报，营业利润约 209.1 亿美元，稀释后每股收益 44.75 美元，其中数字资产公允价值变动收益约 209.1 亿美元。截至 10 月 25 日，公司持有约 848,517 枚比特币，年初至今增加约 26%，按约 8.12 万美元计价市值约 689 亿美元，成本约 640.2 亿美元。软件业务营收 1.254 亿美元，同比下降 3%。

公司称年初至今已筹集约 212 亿美元股本资本，并购买约 143.3 亿美元比特币。现任首席财务官 Andrew Kang 因个人原因将于 11 月 5 日离任，过渡期内由首席执行官 Phong Le 兼任财务负责人，执行副总裁 Reza Virasteh 将自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起出任首席财务官并与 Le 共同担任财务负责人。公司还披露年初至今回购约 20.4 亿美元 STRC，并将美元资产增至约 50.7 亿美元。

据 BIT 股票平台数据显示，Strategy (MSTR) 收盘跌 2.44%，收盘再跌 5.11%。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar
items.content:
Binance hack rattles markets as BNB falls 8%, Bitcoin nears $77K
Bitcoin, Ether and the broader crypto market took a dive as Binance suffered a multibillion-dollar hack.
Update, Oct. 30 at 1:19 am UTC: This article has been updated with fresh market data, Binance’s pledge to cover all losses and its revised frozen assets total.
Cryptocurrency markets extended their decline early Friday following the Binance hack, with BNB down more than 8% over 24 hours and Bitcoin trading near $77,000.
BNB, the native token of BNB Chain, traded near $693, down around 8.2%, according to CoinGecko data at the time of writing. Bitcoin fell 4.8% to about $77,131, while Ether declined 5.7% to about $2,217.
Binance pledged to cover all losses from the hack and suspended all deposits and withdrawals while conducting security checks. In a subsequent update, the exchange put the verified total of frozen assets at around $3 billion, up from its earlier figure of $2.54 billion.
Decentralized finance tokens also declined. Aave’s AAVE fell 11.3% to $118.54, while Uniswap’s UNI dropped 10.4% to $6.48, according to CoinGecko.
Aave said it had frozen new deposits and borrowing across its community-operated V3 and V4 markets as a precaution. The lending platform said its contracts were unaffected and users could still withdraw funds and repay loans.
Bitcoin traded below $77,000 as BNB fell 8% over 24 hours. Source: CoinGecko
The Bitcoin Fear and Greed Index fell to “fear” at a score of 30, its lowest since Aug. 14.

items.title: Binance Investigates Suspicious Crypto Transfers Worth Up to $5.8 Billion

items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.content:
In brief
- Wallets tied to the suspected Binance hack received tens of thousands of ETH from Uniswap contracts and borrowed 19,762 ETH on Aave against about $60 million in USDT, with no sign of a flaw in either app.
- About 253,000 ETH, roughly $570 million, sat in two wallets with no outgoing transfers as of 22:07 UTC, and ETH has no issuer that can freeze it.
- Ripple has frozen about $200 million in RLUSD, per Binance co-CEO Yi He, on top of the more than $2 billion in USDT and USDC.
The attacker behind the wallets draining Binance is using decentralized exchanges such as Uniswap and Aave as exits, swapping stablecoins that issuers can freeze for Ethereum that nobody can, according to Etherscan records for 10 wallets, eight of them labeled as exploiters.
Earlier today, wallets linked to the world’s largest crypto exchange were drained of at least $5.5 billion, with the total tally still climbing. The company said it was investigating the security incident but did not confirm user funds were affected, though security experts widely believe the exchange was indeed hacked. It stands to be the largest hack in the crypto industry's 18-year history.
Stablecoin issuers Tether and Circle moved quickly to blacklist the suspected attacker’s addresses in order to freeze a portion of the funds and make them inaccessible. As centralized issuers, they each have the ability to blacklist addresses so their tokens cannot move, and more than $2 billion of those two tokens have been frozen so far by different stablecoin providers. ETH has no issuer, so every dollar converted before a freeze lands is out of their reach.
The swaps run through Uniswap, a decentralized exchange where trades settle automatically with no company in the middle.
One relay wallet received 20,940 ETH ($45.58 Million) from Uniswap’s UniswapX contract at 20:34 UTC, another got 3,552 ETH (over $8 million) at 20:47, and two later wallets took in about 18,085 ETH (around $41 million) from Uniswap contracts, in 7,444 ETH and 10,642 ETH batches, and about 16,498 ETH ($37.5 million), in 6,946 ETH and 9,552 ETH batches.
Aave, a lending app where users deposit crypto as collateral to borrow other coins, offered a second exit. Between 20:57 and 21:01 UTC, one wallet deposited $10 million and then $50 million in USDT and borrowed 3,271 ETH ($7.43 million) and then 16,491 ETH ($37.47 million) against it, which prompted cybersecurity experts Odysseas Lamtzidi, founder of Phylax Systems, to warn of “contagion in full effect.”
Update: https://t.co/G3Z72cuDXM
They just approved AAVE.
Contagion in full effect https://t.co/aNz2snt8E6
— Odysseus | phylax.systems (@odysseas_eth) October 29, 2026
Aave has since frozen its V3 markets on Ethereum mainnet, which blocks new deposits and borrowing.
Kamino, a decentralized finance protocol built on the Solana blockchain, also paused its Solana and Bitcoin markets as a precautionary measure.
Kamino can confirm that it is currently unaffected by the ongoing Binance situation
Out of an abundance of caution, we have temporarily paused borrowing in the SOL/BTC Market
We are actively monitoring the situation and are in communication with various partners. Any further…
— Kamino (@kamino) October 29, 2026
The ETH is piling up rather than moving on. A wallet labeled Exploiter 8 still held 195,460 ETH ($444.2 million) at 22:03 UTC, and another 57,891.77 ETH ($131.6 million) reached one labeled Exploiter 11, together about 253,000 ETH, or roughly $570 million. That second pile arrived after four hops in 28 minutes, from Exploiter 4 to 5, 5 to 6, 6 to 7 and 7 to 11.
The attacker also swapped 36 million RLUSD, Ripple’s dollar-backed stablecoin, for 15,439 ETH, while 52.54 million RLUSD remained unfrozen at the holding wallet, according to an on-chain update circulating on X. Etherscan showed the main receiving wallet holding about $88.5 million in RLUSD at 20:41 UTC, which matches the two figures combined.
Ripple has since frozen about $200 million, according to Binance co-CEO Yi He. “Thanks to the Ripple team for promptly freezing approximately 200 million. User Funds are SAFU,” a reference to the exchange’s emergency reserve fund, Yi He wrote on X.
“Ripple is closely monitoring reports of a potential exploit involving Binance and its attackers’ RLUSD holdings and we are actively freezing affected funds,” Jack McDonald, Ripple’s senior vice president for stablecoins, said in a statement. “We’re coordinating with relevant parties and stand ready to support any investigation and appropriate action to keep users protected.”
Ripple is closely monitoring reports of a potential exploit involving Binance and its attackers’ RLUSD holdings and we are actively freezing affected funds. We’re coordinating with relevant parties and stand ready to support any investigation and appropriate action to keep users…
— Jack McDonald (@_JackMcDonald_) October 29, 2026
Tornado Cash, a mixer that scrambles the trail of crypto payments, appears so far only as funding for the address that set up the attack.
After the Bybit hack, North Korea’s Lazarus Group converted 84.45% of the stolen ETH to Bitcoin through Thorchain, a cross-chain swap network, per Bybit’s CEO. Monero, a privacy coin that hides who sent what, rose about 6% on Thursday, suggesting a possible rotation into the privacy coin.

items.author: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton
items.content:
Tampered Ledger reported in Singapore a month before news broke: Asia Express
Singapore police say tampered Ledgers started showing up there on September 10. South Korean lawmakers look set to delay the crypto tax law for a fourth time.
Tampered Ledger wallets cost Singapore users $2.7M: Police
Singapore police say at least two cases involving tampered Ledger hardware wallets have been reported since Sept. 10, with combined losses of about 3.5 million Singapore dollars ($2.7 million). It places the first local report almost a month before the wider incident became public.
It’s not clear from the October 28 consumer alert if the September 10 case was reported to police at the time, or was made retrospectively. If the report was timely, it raises questions as to whether Ledger was informed, or if the Singapore Police Force was in a position to issue a public warning earlier. However, the October 28 advisory suggested the police investigation was still in the preliminary stages.
Ledger issued a public alert about tampered Ledgers being found in the CryptoBilis supply chain on October 9. Almost $100 million was drained from wallets containing spyware components.
On Oct. 13, Ledger said it has asked retailers in Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Hong Kong to suspend sales of Ledger devices as investigations are ongoing.
Singapore police issue tampered Ledgers warning three weeks after the story broke. Source: Singapore Police
Malaysia, Thailand join Singapore’s cross-border stablecoin push
Bank Negara Malaysia and the Bank of Thailand joined Singapore’s BLOOM initiative on Friday as policymaker members.
BLOOM, short for Borderless, Liquid, Open, Online, Multi-currency, is a public-private initiative that intends to help financial institutions use stablecoins and tokenized deposits for cross-border payments. It was launched by the Monetary Authority of Singapore in October last year and counts Airwallex, Mastercard, Ripple, Visa and the World Bank Group as members.
DBS survey finds lots of corporate interest in tokenized money
A survey by Singapore bank DBS found that almost 90% of 422 global businesses surveyed are either adopting, or are interested in adopting, tokenized cash to accelerate payments.
SOUTH KOREA
Groundhog Day as Korean lawmakers consider fourth delay of crypto tax
Government officials in South Korea are reportedly weighing another delay of the country’s cryptocurrency tax policy, currently scheduled to be implemented in January 2027.
According to a Monday report from South Korean news outlet Newsis, the crypto income tax could be pushed to 2029 in part because it’s the earliest that officials will be able to share information on taxes related to digital asset exchanges with the US.
The policy, which would impose a 22% tax on crypto gains for investors earning more than 2.5 million Korean won ($1,883) annually.
Bithumb and two other firms report data breaches
Bithumb said its in-house mobile system was hacked and personal information leaked. Brokerage Daishin Securities reported roughly 38,000 customer records exposed and asset manager Mirae Asset Global Investments confirmed a hacking incident.
South Korea to regulate stablecoins as payment means, and require monthly balance reporting for cross border transfers
The South Korean government and the Bank of Korea intend to draft amendments to the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act within this year to regulate stablecoins used as payment instruments. The central bank will also require crypto transfer service providers to send monthly reports from December 2 — but extending back to mid 2024 — about who exactly has been sending money out of the country.
NORTH KOREA
Chainalysis traces North Korean crypto cash-outs through Garantex
Blockchain analytics company Chainalysis mapped a long-running network of Russian intermediaries that helped North Korean IT workers cash out millions of dollars in cryptocurrency.
The US Treasury Department’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) sanctioned 10 individuals and one entity on Wednesday for supporting North Korean government-run IT worker schemes that it said funded the country’s weapons programs, according to a press release.
Those sanctioned included Russian nationals Ilya Aleksandrovich Boykov and Vitold Viktorovich Obertas.
HONG KONG
Hong Kong names Nasdaq-listed Solana Company a strategic enterprise
Hong Kong has named Nasdaq-listed Solana Company (HSDT) a strategic enterprise under a government program aimed at attracting businesses that support the city’s economic development.
Solana Company said Thursday that it was among the seventh batch of businesses selected by Hong Kong’s Office for Attracting Strategic Enterprises (OASES) and the only blockchain infrastructure company onboarded by the office in 2026.
Hong Kong’s government confirmed the addition of 18 enterprises to the program last week, bringing its total to 142.
China uses Hong Kong as a launchpad for the Digital Yuan
The South China Morning Post reported that Beijing wants Hong Kong to help seed international use of the digital yuan.
RedotPay plans a US IPO
Hong Kong crypto payments firm RedotPay plans to launch an IPO in the US before the end of the year, and has launched a pre-IPO funding round valuing the company at $4 billion.
CHINA
China targets 2030 for its national blockchain network buildout
China has set a 2030 target for largely completing a national blockchain network under a five-year digital development plan published Friday.
The new plan also calls for stronger blockchain technical standards and greater use of the technology in data circulation and trading.
Mainland China bans cryptocurrency-related business activities, but promotes blockchain technology as a national priority. Critics say that blockchain-not-crypto has never worked before.
THAILAND
Supreme Court recognizes Bitcoin as legal property
Thailand’s Supreme Court has ruled that Bitcoin qualifies as property under criminal law, setting a precedent that may influence how Thai courts treat other cryptocurrencies. The case involved upholding a 10-year prison sentence in a robbery case involving about $50,000 in Bitcoin.
Thailand launches crypto wallet for tourists
Thailand has launched the terribly named WORPT digital wallet so that tourists can convert USDT or USDC into Thai baht in order to spend via PromptPay QR codes. The scheme is part of the Tourist DigiPay sandbox.

items.author: wublockchainenglish
items.content:
CZ: Binance May Have Been Hacked as Tether and Circle Freeze Over $2.3B in Stablecoins

Breaking: Binance co-founder Changpeng Zhao (CZ) said the exchange appeared to have been hacked but that user funds were safe. Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino said the company had frozen over 1.567 billion USDT linked to the potential hack, while Circle CEO Jeremy Allaire said Circle had frozen more than 800 million USDC associated with the incident in coordination with law enforcement. CZ thanked both companies and said that although he no longer manages Binance, he expects all user funds to be fully covered.

Binance said it is actively investigating reports of a potential security issue and confirmed that user funds are completely safe. Its security team is urgently reviewing the situation and will provide updates through official channels once information is verified. Binance also warned users to beware of scams, unofficial links, messages, and requests for account information.

Binance said its team is conducting security checks and that withdrawals will resume as soon as the security issue is fully resolved. The exchange reiterated that user funds remain safe and said it will provide further updates.

Binance said it has temporarily suspended Binance Alpha trading as part of its ongoing security measures, including token purchases and instant trading using funds from spot wallets. Trading will resume once the security issue is resolved.

Binance said the current verified total of frozen assets stands at $2.54 billion, clarifying conflicting figures circulating publicly, including reports of $1.8 billion. The amount may increase as Binance works with law enforcement, asset issuers, blockchain intelligence firms, and industry partners to trace and freeze additional assets. Binance said it will only disclose confirmed figures and provide updates as more information is verified. — link

items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.content:
In brief
- At least $5.57 billion left Binance-linked wallets on Ethereum, Bitcoin and Tron on Thursday, per an on-chain tally; Binance said it is investigating.
- Tether froze 975.1 million USDT and Circle froze 823 million USDC in the main receiving wallet, about $1.8 billion in total.
- Bitcoin fell below $79,000, BNB dropped about 7% and Monero rose about 6%.
At least $5.57 billion in crypto has left wallets linked to Binance across three blockchains in what appears to be a breach of the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange.
If confirmed as a hack, it would be the biggest crypto hack on record. Binance has not confirmed its exchange has been hacked but said it is aware of the “potential security issue and is actively investigating.”
“We have not confirmed any impact to user funds,” the company posted on X. “Our security teams are reviewing all relevant information with urgency, and we will provide updates through official Binance channels as soon as we have verified information.”
Our teams are aware of reports of a potential security issue and are actively investigating. At this stage, we have not confirmed any impact to user funds.
Our security teams are reviewing all relevant information with urgency, and we will provide updates through official… pic.twitter.com/dN76yhzYM0
— Binance (@binance) October 29, 2026
Binance is the world's largest crypto exchange, where millions of people buy, sell and store their coins. The money came from its hot wallets, the internet-connected wallets exchanges use to process customer withdrawals.
The tally counts $3.51 billion on Ethereum, $1.44 billion in 18,270 Bitcoin and $630 million on Tron. The first Ethereum transaction, at 20:24 UTC, sent 167,464 ETH plus 63 token transfers to a brand-new address, including 1.615 billion USDT, a stablecoin built to always trade at $1, according to Etherscan.
Three minutes earlier, an address funded through Tornado Cash, a mixer that scrambles the trail of crypto payments, submitted a delegation for a Binance hot wallet using EIP-7702, an Ethereum feature that lets an ordinary wallet run smart-contract code. “7702 lets a normal wallet execute delegated code. The delegation persists; that code can authorize later transfers without another signature from the wallet,” Odysseas Lamtzidi, founder of Phylax Systems wrote on X.
1/4 EIP-7702 can turn the wallet itself into the sweeper.
A Binance-labeled wallet moved 167,464 ETH + 63 tokens, including 1.615B USDT, just 3m24s after a signed delegation was installed.
This is bad.https://t.co/GrvUiya16D pic.twitter.com/zONu8cwW63
— Odysseus | phylax.systems (@odysseas_eth) October 29, 2026
How the attacker got the required signature is still unknown. Tether froze 975.1 million USDT in the main receiving address, and Circle, issuer of the rival stablecoin USDC, froze 823 million USDC in the same wallet at 21:04 UTC, bringing the total frozen to about $1.8 billion. Both issuers can block specific addresses from moving their tokens, but the attacker is moving funds fast.
"Circle is closely tracking reports of a potential exploit involving Binance," Circle CEO Jeremy Allaire posted on X. "In coordination with law enforcement, we have frozen more than 800M USDC associated with the incident and will continue supporting the investigation."
Total on the hack is at least $5.57B across 3 chains (likely more)
Tether has started freezing and this time even Circle acted and managed to freeze 800M in a single wallet.
Total frozen: $1.8B
Still $800M could be frozen, attacker is moving funds fast https://t.co/km4eyJWEa8 pic.twitter.com/IL6wBfZK2r
— Wazz (@WazzCrypto) October 29, 2026
Bitcoin slid below $79,000, down about 2.6% in 24 hours, while BNB, Binance's own token, fell about 7% to roughly $699. Monero, a privacy coin that hides who sent what, rose about 6% to $637, echoing the jump of as much as 51% it posted after a $333 million Bitcoin theft in April 2025.
Binance lost 7,000 Bitcoin, about $40 million, in a 2019 hack. The $5.57 billion tally would be more than triple the roughly $1.5 billion Bybit heist in February 2025, the previous record.

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Live updates: Binance $6.3B hack linked to North Korea’s TraderTraitor
Follow live updates as Binance says $6.3 billion in assets have been stolen in a major hack. Around $3 billion in stolen funds have been frozen.
What we know about the Binance hack:
- Binance says the estimated total impact is around $6.3 billion and the verified total value of crypto frozen is $3 billion. This could increase as investigators trace additional assets.
- Binance says deposits are operating normally, and withdrawals are expected to resume within 48 hours.
- Assets frozen include Tether USDt (USDT), USDC (USDC), Ripple USD (RLUSD), World Liberty Financial USD (USD1), StraitsX USD (XUSD), USDT0 (USDT0), Wrapped Beacon ETH (WBETH), Tether Gold (XAUT), Pax Gold (PAXG), Pax Dollar (USDP) and Arbitrum (ARB).
- Cybersecurity analysts suspect North Korea’s TraderTraitor is behind the attack.
Oct. 30 at 05:01 am UTC
Analysts suspect North Korean group behind Binance hack
Chainalysis co-founder and CEO Jonathan Levin said the Binance hack was likely carried out by North Korean hacking group TraderTraitor, citing links to a previous hack.
In a post on X, Levin put the theft at $6.4 billion, slightly above Binance’s estimated $6.3 billion impact. He said industry partners had frozen approximately $3 billion and Chainalysis was continuing to track the funds.
In a separate post, onchain investigator ZachXBT said the stolen funds from the Binance attack and the earlier Bitget exploit were commingled in the same address on Friday, after arriving via THORChain.
“This indicates the same actor is likely behind both incidents,” he said.
“The Bitget exploit was attributed to DPRK-linked TraiderTraitor, which had overlap with other previous exploits such as Kelp DAO,” he added.
Speaking to Cointelegraph, Blockaid co-founder and CEO Ido Ben-Natan also said the attack resembled the work of North Korea, or DPRK, based on the sophisticated onchain preparations, customer sweeper contract and multiple authorizations.
TRM Labs has also attributed the attack to TraderTraitor with “high confidence,” which it said is “based on robust on and off-chain intelligence.”
TraderTraitor has also been named by the FBI as the same group responsible for the ByBit hack in February last year.
Oct. 30 at 4:17 am UTC
Binance expects withdrawals to resume within 48 hours
Binance said withdrawals remain paused while it completes a security revamp of its withdrawal service and related addresses, with service expected to resume within 48 hours. Deposits are operating normally.
The exchange said the incident involved multiple factors and that its security team was tracing the full attack path through a compromised computer, which they suspect to be the entry point.
Oct. 30 at 03:49 am UTC
Binance hack could accelerate shift to DEXs: Standard Chartered
The Binance hack could push more crypto trading toward decentralized exchanges and benefit Uniswap over the longer term, according to Standard Chartered’s global head of digital assets research, Geoffrey Kendrick.
In an email shared with Cointelegraph, Kendrick retained his $100 price target for Uniswap’s UNI token by 2030, saying the breach was “another reason why that forecast may end up being too low.”
CoinGecko research shows that the top 10 spot DEX-to-CEX ratio was 23.5% in the second quarter of 2026, climbing 2.1 percentage points from the first quarter of 2026.
“I would encourage investors to re-engage with Uniswap,” said Kendrick. “The decentralized exchange (DEX) has never had any exploits, and the hack of the largest centralized exchange (CEX), in Binance, should see the ratio of DEX to CEX trading continue to increase.”
Oct. 30 at 02:25 am UTC
Binance points to engineer’s hacked laptop in $6.3B breach
Binance said its initial investigation into the multi-billion crypto breach has pointed to a compromised DevOps engineer’s laptop.
The exchange said the laptop compromise may have allowed an attacker to access a service container and submit unauthorized withdrawal transactions. It said it had found no evidence of a wallet private-key leak, though its investigation remains ongoing.
The crypto exchange has also disclosed that the estimated total impact of the hack is $6.3 billion.
Oct. 30 at 02:21 am UTC
First Digital confirms it has frozen FDUSD involved in attack
First Digital CEO Vincent Chok said it has frozen the FDUSD stolen in the attack on Binance.
“We’re working alongside the Binance team and will share updates as we have them,” Chok told Cointelegraph in a written statement.
“Our priority is protecting FDUSD holders and stopping bad actors from moving stolen funds. Protecting users is a responsibility we all share.”
Oct. 30 at 01:19 am UTC
Bitcoin trades below $77,000 as BNB falls 8%
Bitcoin traded near $76,937, down 4.9% over 24 hours, according to CoinGecko. BNB fell 8% to about $693, while Ether declined 5.7% to about $2,211.
DeFi tokens also fell, with AAVE down 11.3% and Uniswap’s UNI down 10.7% over the same period.
The Bitcoin Fear and Greed Index, which tracks Bitcoin market sentiment, fell to “fear” with a score of 30, which it has not seen since August.
Oct. 30 at 12:52 am UTC
Binance says $3 billion frozen from hack
Binance said the current verified amount of assets frozen from the hack is now $3 billion.
The update came after the Arbitrum Security Council said it executed a transaction to freeze $30.5 million from the Binance exploit, involving 74.6 million Arbitrum (ARB) and 8,425 Ether (ETH).
“The Security Council acted by weighing its commitment to the security and integrity of the Arbitrum community and Arbitrum governance without impacting any Arbitrum users or applications,” it said.
“As of October 30, 2026 time, the funds have been successfully transferred to an intermediary frozen wallet,” it said.
The funds will no longer be accessible to the address that originally held the funds and can only be moved by further action of the Security Council or a vote of Arbitrum DAO governance, it added.
Oct. 30 at 12:26 am UTC
Chainalysis estimates $5.9 billion stolen from Binance
Chainalysis said its current estimate of the amount stolen from Binance is $5.912 billion at the time of theft, four times the amount stolen from crypto exchange Bybit in 2025.
Binance earlier said the verified total frozen is $2.54 billion.
Oct. 30 at 12:26 am UTC
Blockaid suspects Binance hack involved private key “misuse”
The suspected multi-billion-dollar Binance hack may have involved attackers manipulating the exchange’s transaction-signing signature, according to Blockaid co-founder and CEO Ido Ben-Natan.
Speaking to Cointelegraph, Ben-Natan said Blockaid’s preliminary assessment pointed to “key misuse,” in which attackers trick or compromise a signing system into authorizing malicious transactions without extracting the underlying private key.
“It seems to be… a compromise of signing infrastructure. We don’t think a key was leaked,” he said.
Ben-Natan said this was a preliminary assessment, drawing on their experience with similar attacks and their observations of the onchain activity.
Arkham CEO Miguel Morel said the attack appears to be ongoing.
Oct. 30 at 12:07 am UTC
Binance says deposits temporarily suspended
Binance said it has temporarily suspended deposits as it conducts security checks, freezes funds and coordinates with law enforcement. It previously confirmed it had suspended withdrawals.
“We are working around the clock and will share a full post-mortem once the investigation is complete,” the company said, adding it will “cover all losses.”
Earlier, Binance also said it had temporarily suspended Binance Alpha trading.
Oct. 30 at 12:07 am UTC
Wintermute and GSR disclose Binance exposure
Crypto trading firms Wintermute and GSR disclosed exposure to Binance but said they did not expect major disruption to their businesses.
The firms are market makers, which place buy and sell orders on exchanges to help other traders complete transactions. A disruption to their operations could make trading harder or more expensive across crypto markets.
GSR CEO Xin Song said its Binance exposure was less than 5% of its net equity, meaning the value of its assets minus its liabilities. He said GSR was working with Binance to understand the incident and identify ways to help.
Wintermute CEO Evgeny Gaevoy said his firm’s exposure was less than 20% of net equity and that he did not expect operational disruption.
Neither executive disclosed a dollar amount for the exposure or confirmed financial losses.
Oct. 29 at 11:40 pm UTC
Ripple freezes RLUSD linked to Binance hack
Ripple is freezing holdings of its dollar-pegged RLUSD stablecoin linked to the Binance hack, according to Jack McDonald, the company’s senior vice president of stablecoins.
McDonald said Ripple was “actively freezing affected funds” and coordinating with relevant parties to support the investigation. He did not disclose the amount frozen.
Oct. 29 at 11:35 pm UTC
Binance says $2.54 billion frozen after hack
Binance said the verified total of assets frozen in connection with the hack had reached $2.54 billion, clarifying differing figures circulating publicly, including references to $1.8 billion.
The exchange said the total could increase as its teams work with law enforcement, issuers, blockchain intelligence firms and industry partners to trace and freeze additional assets. Binance said it would publish further figures once verified.
Oct. 29 at 10:36 pm UTC
World Liberty Financial freezes $27 million in USD1
World Liberty Financial has frozen $27 million in US-dollar-pegged stablecoin USD1 and $2 million worth of WLFI, according to Binance co-founder Yi He.
“USD1 has taken proactive steps to freeze the $27 million in USD1 associated with the Binance hack,” said World Liberty Financial co-founder and CEO Zach Witkoff.
World Liberty Financial said it worked with BitGo to freeze the stolen WLFI and USD1 funds.
“We will cooperate fully with the ongoing investigation and support efforts to hold those responsible accountable. Protecting our users remains a top priority,” said World Liberty in a post on X.
Oct. 29 at 10:33 pm UTC
Binance says withdrawals will resume once issues resolved
Binance says its team is conducting security checks and will resume withdrawals as soon as the “security issue” is resolved.
Oct. 29 at 10:32 pm UTC
Aave freezes markets after Binance exploiter borrows $44.6 million
Decentralized lending protocol Aave froze markets across its V3 and V4 deployments as a precaution following the Binance hack.
In a governance forum update posted after the freeze, risk service provider LlamaRisk said the Binance exploiter deposited 60 million USDT and borrowed 19,762 Wrapped Ether (WETH), worth about $44.6 million at the time.
The borrowing occurred between 8:58 pm and 9:01 pm UTC on Oct. 29, about 40 minutes before the first freeze. It was the exploiter’s only Aave position across all networks and versions, with no further interactions detected after 9:01 pm UTC.
The position remained backed by $59.9 million in USDT collateral against $43.8 million in debt at the update’s snapshot. LlamaRisk said it remained subject to normal liquidation and did not put Aave suppliers at risk.
The freezes covered 175 reserves on V3 across 16 networks and 117 reserves on V4 across four networks.
Users can still withdraw funds and repay loans, and liquidations continue. However, the freeze prevents new deposits and borrowing, including additional collateral deposits, leaving repayment as the only way to improve an existing position’s health factor.
LlamaRisk said markets would remain frozen until the exploiter’s funds stopped moving and Binance provided greater clarity on containment, followed by a staged reopening. It warned that a prolonged freeze could push borrowing rates higher as withdrawals reduce available liquidity.
Oct. 29 at 9:15 pm UTC
Binance investigates multibillion-dollar security breach
Binance is investigating a potential multibillion-dollar security breach involving one of its Ethereum wallets, after suspicious transfers prompted stablecoin issuers Tether and Circle to reportedly freeze billions in assets.
A Binance spokesperson told Cointelegraph on Thursday that the exchange was investigating reports of a potential security issue but had not confirmed any impact on user funds. The spokesperson said its security teams were reviewing the activity and would provide updates once more information was verified.
Concerns were first raised by blockchain researcher Spreek, who posted on X that assets from a Binance-linked Ethereum wallet had been transferred to a newly created address through a contract call allegedly funded by Tornado Cash. Spreek later reported that wallets connected to the transfers had begun selling Tether USDt (USDT) through decentralized exchanges.
Blockchain analytics platform Arkham Intelligence later identified a collection of wallets labeled “binance-hacker-1029” holding approximately $5.84 billion in digital assets. The figure represents the wallets’ reported holdings rather than a confirmed estimate of stolen funds.
Binance co-founder Changpeng Zhao said the activity appeared to be a hack, adding that Tether and Circle had frozen approximately $971 million and $823 million, respectively. Zhao said he expected all user funds to be fully covered.
Source: Arkham Intelligence
Tether, Circle freeze over $2.36 billion
Blockchain security firm Blockaid said its team had identified roughly $3.3 billion in suspicious transfers involving Binance-linked wallets across Ethereum, Arbitrum and Avalanche.
Shortly after news of the hack emerged, Tether and Circle, the two largest stablecoin issuers by market capitalization, said they had frozen a combined $2.36 billion in tokens linked to the suspected incident.
Circle CEO Jeremy Allaire said the company had frozen more than $800 million in USDC in coordination with law enforcement and would continue supporting the investigation.
A few minutes later, Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino said the company had frozen more than $1.567 billion in USDT linked to the potential exploit.
“Protecting the industry and our partners is our main priority,” Ardoino wrote.
Source: Paolo Ardoino
The Binance hack came hours after Polymarket temporarily halted trading following a compromise at a third-party provider. The prediction market platform said it had fixed the issue and pledged to reimburse affected users, with all systems reported operational by 7:05 p.m. UTC Thursday.
Reporting by Felix Ng, Bryan O’Shea and Nate Kostar.

items.author: Decrypt Staff
items.content:
In brief
- Coinbase posted $719 million in Q3 net income, or $2.51 per share, against an expected loss, though about $715 million came from gains on crypto it holds. Adjusted net income was $78 million.
- Revenue of $1.22 billion was in line with estimates and flat from the prior quarter, down 35% from a year earlier.
- Prediction markets topped $200 million in annualized revenue, and subscription and services revenue reached nearly half of net revenue.
Coinbase is back in the black, though much of that came from the crypto on its own balance sheet.
The exchange reported third-quarter net income of $719 million, or $2.51 per diluted share, on Thursday, ending a two-quarter losing streak. Analysts had expected a loss of 15 cents per share, according to Zacks. But about $715 million of the profit came from gains on crypto Coinbase holds as an investment. Excluding those and other investment gains, adjusted net income was $78 million.
Total revenue came in at $1.22 billion, in line with expectations, flat from the second quarter and down 35% from a year earlier. Transaction revenue slipped 1% to $590 million but beat the roughly $527 million analysts expected, as crypto volatility sank to multiyear lows and trading volume across the market fell.
The standout was prediction markets, which crossed $200 million in annualized revenue, making it one of the fastest-growing products in Coinbase’s history, the company said.
Daily traders grew more than 60% from the prior quarter, and revenue has compounded 82% per quarter since launch. CEO Brian Armstrong said the product kept “growing even through slower sports months.”
Subscription and services revenue rose 3% to $570 million, nearly half of net revenue, led by $307 million from stablecoins. Average USDC held in Coinbase products hit a record $22 billion. Paid Coinbase One subscribers reached an all-time high, up 24% from a year earlier, and the exchange’s share of global crypto trading volume rose to 10.7%, its fourth straight quarterly gain.
“Prediction markets are adding another revenue stream and are less correlated to crypto volatility,” CFO Alesia Haas said.
Coinbase also cut its 2026 adjusted expense guidance by another $100 million at the midpoint, to between $4.15 billion and $4.3 billion, following cost reductions in May. Adjusted EBITDA jumped 60% from the prior quarter to $333 million. Through Oct. 25, fourth-quarter transaction revenue stood at about $165 million.
The positive results follow two consecutive losing quarters. Coinbase posted a $394 million loss in the first quarter and missed estimates in the second as trading activity slowed, though analysts said at the time they weren’t worried about the stock’s slide.
Shares closed Thursday at $160.59, down 1.1%, before the results came out, and were little changed in after-hours trading. The stock is down more than 55% from its 52-week high of $361.40.

items.author: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi
items.content:
Here’s what happened in crypto today
Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
Today in crypto, prediction market platform Kalshi raised $1 billion at a $40 billion valuation, cryptocurrency exchange HTX agreed to halt unlawful promotions in the UK following legal action by the Financial Conduct Authority and CFTC Chair Michael Selig outlined a future where AI-powered refrigerators could stake Ether and launch memecoins.
Kalshi hits $40 billion valuation after $1 billion funding round
Prediction market platform Kalshi has raised $1 billion at a $40 billion valuation, nearly doubling since May as it expands beyond sports contracts.
Wellington Management and Sequoia Capital co-led the Series G round, Reuters reported Thursday. Kalshi also disclosed that its non-sports markets have surpassed $1 billion in annualized revenue, according to The Wall Street Journal.
The latest financing follows a $1 billion raise in May that valued Kalshi at $22 billion. The platform has since recorded approximately $15.8 billion in trading volume over the past 30 days, according to DefiLlama.
Kalshi is also expanding its commercial partnerships. Earlier this week, the NBA named Kalshi and rival Polymarket as preferred prediction market exchanges, while S&P Dow Jones Indices partnered with Kalshi to introduce financial benchmarks to event contracts.
The expansion comes amid mounting legal scrutiny of Kalshi’s sports contracts. Utah filed criminal charges against the company and its co-founders Wednesday over alleged illegal gambling activities, escalating a dispute over whether prediction markets fall under federal derivatives oversight or state gambling laws. The Commodity Futures Trading Commission has separately moved to block Utah’s enforcement efforts.
HTX agrees to halt unlawful UK crypto promotions after FCA case
Cryptocurrency exchange HTX has agreed to stop unlawfully promoting its services to consumers in the United Kingdom under a settlement announced Thursday by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA).
Huobi Global S.A., the Panamanian company behind HTX, agreed that it would not knowingly run illegal promotions, including through the exchange’s website, apps or social media. The court undertakings run until Oct. 21, 2031.
The settlement terms are confidential, and the agreement does not constitute an admission of liability or wrongdoing.
“Crypto firms should be under no illusion: being based overseas does not put them beyond the reach of UK law,” said Steve Smart, executive director of enforcement and market oversight at the FCA. “The message to other firms is clear: follow the rules or face the consequences.”
In an Oct. 16 notice outlining its UK exit arrangements, the exchange formerly known as Huobi said existing UK accounts could no longer deposit or trade. Eligible users can request a one-time 48-hour window to withdraw remaining assets, subject to approval and compliance checks. Accounts will close after all assets have been withdrawn.
The FCA brought the case in October 2025 and announced it in February, which it said was the agency’s first enforcement action against a crypto firm over illegal marketing.
Your fridge could one day stake Ether, launch memecoins: CFTC chair
Commodity Futures Trading Commission Chair Michael Selig says it is “no longer science fiction” to imagine one’s refrigerator autonomously purchasing groceries with money earned from staking Ether — or even launching its own memecoin, raising questions about how regulators should oversee autonomous AI agents.
The colorful comment came during Selig’s remarks at the CFTC’s inaugural Frontier Forum in Washington, DC, on Wednesday, where he argued that regulators must adapt to a financial system where AI agents can hold assets and execute trades autonomously.
“We’re gathered here today to discuss a technology that’s rapidly transforming the financial markets. President Trump calls it ‘super intelligence,’ or SI, because ‘it’s not artificial.’ It’s as real as the printing press, the steam engine, and the internet,” he said.
The regulatory questions come as younger investors embrace AI tools for managing money. An eToro survey published in September found that 79% of US millennial investors and 77% of Gen Z investors already used or were open to using AI to select or adjust their investments, highlighting the potential reach of rules governing automated finance.

items.author: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar
items.content:
Public companies double share of blockchain revenue since 2022: Report
A new 1kx report finds that public companies are capturing a larger share of blockchain revenue, driven by institutional adoption and real-world applications.
Publicly traded companies accounted for 16% of blockchain industry revenue in 2026, more than double their 7% share in 2022, according to a new report from crypto investment firm 1kx.
The increase comes as overall blockchain revenue is projected to decline 28% year over year to roughly $100 billion in 2026. The report analyzed data from more than 2,600 protocols and earnings reports from 104 publicly traded companies through the third quarter.
The researchers attributed the growing share of public companies partly to new stock market listings, including stablecoin issuer Circle, which went public in 2025, and revenue growth among existing companies. The 10 largest publicly traded companies in the study doubled their blockchain-related revenue over the past three years.
Coinbase and Circle generated approximately $3.3 billion in combined blockchain-related revenue in the first half of 2026, according to 1kx, while publicly traded Bitcoin miners earned roughly $2 billion. Traditional financial firms, including JPMorgan, BlackRock, CME Group, Visa and Robinhood, accounted for another $1.1 billion collectively.
Revenue remains concentrated among a relatively small number of businesses. The six largest publicly traded companies accounted for roughly 50% to 60% of the group’s revenue, according to the report.
Related: BlackRock files for third Bitcoin ETF, still no Solana or XRP
Institutional and real-world activity gains share of blockchain revenue
The report also found that revenue from broader economic activity surpassed blockchain infrastructure revenue for the first time in the third quarter, reaching approximately $5.3 billion compared with $5.1 billion, according to 1kx.
The category, which includes tokenized assets, payments and prediction markets, grew 58% year over year in the first half of 2026. Together with institutional adoption, it accounted for 33% of total blockchain revenue in the third quarter, with the report projecting a 30% share for the full year.
Institutional and broader economic activity to reach 30% of blockchain revenue in 2026. Source: 1kx report
RWA.xyz data shows the value of distributed tokenized real-world assets rose roughly 51% over the past year, from $26.16 billion in October 2025 to $39.54 billion as of Thursday. Tokenized equities grew even faster, surging 471% over the same period to $3.77 billion.
